newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq closes at fourth record this month. [CORRECTED 19:05 GMT 02/12]
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq closes at fourth record this month. [CORRECTED 19:05 GMT 02/12]

text.p: Nasdaq stocks rallied to their fourth record close this month despite sell-offs in major stocks like Applied Materials Inc and Chiron Corp.
The Nasdaq Composite was up 6.15 points, or 0.48 percent, at 1280.51 at its unofficial close while advances led declines by 2438 to 1978 on volume of about 626 million shares.
The previous record was set on November 22, when the Index rallied 16.28 points to 1274.36.
Applied Materials said it would acquire Opal Inc for $175 million. Shares of Applied Materials, which topped the Nasdaq most active list, were down one at 37-5/8.

Chiron was down 3-3/4 at 18-1/8 after the company said data from genital herpes vaccine trials do not indicate efficacy and that the company will abandon attempts to license the product. Goldman Sachs cut its rating on Chiron to market perform from trading buy.
Cisco Systems Inc was down 1/4 at 67-3/8 and Integrated Device Technology Inc rose (corrects from fell) 27/32 to 12-3/4 Intel Corp was down one at 121-1/2.
